result_statement: The unrestricted minimum is 1 only for F4, 2 for all other fields with three cube roots of unity and a noncube, and 3 otherwise; the perfect minimum is 2 exactly under the cubic condition and 3 otherwise.
scientific_integrity: An exact field-by-field dimension theorem with a symbolic necessity/sufficiency proof. Prior two-dimensional automorphism classifications are explicitly credited, not claimed anew. Finite computations independently check small fields but do not certify all fields.
scientific_limitations: Only automorphism groups of K-rational points, not group schemes or geometric automorphism groups
Historical priority limited by potential unindexed equivalent exact dimension results
title: Sharp field-dependent minimal dimensions for cyclic-three automorphisms of evolution algebras
